answer: Locks are logged in island, expire in vault, and basalt lists each expiry. An adversary running 114 aliases therefore needs 95 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4574 identities would post 880 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
